title: Symmetric-shell labellings of complete full trees with even branching: proof of the even case of the Bača-Semaničová-Feňovčíková-Lai-Wang local antimagic conjecture (Fundamenta Informaticae 185 (2022), Conjecture 6.1)
exact_endpoint: Antimagic.Round7A.mathdb_354228 : ∀ {V} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (t n : ℕ), 2 ≤ t → Even t → 1 ≤ n → FullTree G t n → IsLeast (spectrum G) (numLeaves G + 1) ∧ chiLA G = numLeaves G + 1; with the model companion Antimagic.Round7A.even_case : IsLeast (spectrum (tree t n)) (t^n + 1); Labeling = edge bijection onto 1..|E|, weight = incident label sum, IsLocal = adjacent weights distinct, chiLA = least colour count, FullTree = rooted full t-ary tree certificate with all leaves at depth n
scope: Bača, Semaničová-Feňovčíková, Lai and Wang, Conjecture 6.1, even case: for every complete full t-ary tree T with t ≥ 2 even, χ_la(T) = l + 1. Proved for every even t ≥ 2 and depth n ≥ 1, for every finite graph carrying the full-tree certificate.

substantive_reason: It proves the full even case of a published conjecture whose source could only place χ_la in {l+1, l+2}: the source's consecutive-block scheme provably cannot reach l + 1 (its Lemma 2.10 forces an extra colour), and the new symmetric-shell labelling with a central hole and the displacement permutation sigma, plus a binary row-two patch, attains l + 1 at every depth. The proof is fully formalized for arbitrary trees through an isomorphism bridge. Significance is a qualified pass, modest.
